source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade BIOS firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade BIOS firmware through web UI.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + BIOS image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- BIOS upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided BIOS image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the BIOS flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with host must be powered off first; after completion verify the BIOS version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the BIOS version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: BIOS firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; preserves host-off and BIOS WebUI scope but treats browser automation as capable of replacing manual WebUI acceptance and invents clean-single-reset evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; strong recovery analysis, but versions, POST criteria and power parameters are identifiable project inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; entry 726/2291 retains the attended BIOS WebUI workflow.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Upgrade and downgrade BIOS through the BMC WebUI while the host is off, then prove the target BIOS becomes active and the server completes POST/boot without required configuration or health regression.
original_method: An engineer leaves BMC standby power available, selects and commits each BIOS image in the BMC WebUI, observes terminal flash status, follows the approved activation/reset sequence and verifies BIOS version, settings, POST/OS and logs.
manual_activity: Image selection, confirmation, flash-progress acceptance and any WebUI recovery prompt are manual core operations; an engineer controls the host-off/activation hand-off.
required_inputs: Platform/current/upgrade/downgrade BIOS versions and signed image hashes
Vendor WebUI region/preservation and activation procedure
Expected BIOS settings, POST/OS and platform health
Known-good image, flashback/recovery media, serial console and OOB
safety_requirements: Verify platform/board, image signature and intended BIOS regions before selection; filename alone is insufficient.
Do not interpret host off as AC removal; preserve BMC power and stable update supply.
Never retry, reverse direction or power-cycle after an uncertain flash; retain WebUI and console errors.
Confirm BIOS recovery/flashback and required settings backup before each approved transition.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare compatibility and baseline evidence, monitor BMC/console/power/logs, and collect post-activation version, settings, POST/OS and SEL data.
Do not drive or claim completion of the manual WebUI core and do not decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve/perform each WebUI image transition and exact activation/reset/power sequence.
Confirm restored BIOS settings and boot health, then issue direction-specific verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It correctly requires host-off and BIOS verification, but browser automation cannot replace manual WebUI acceptance and the source does not require a clean single reset.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI manually; validate the existing IPMI raw version script against this platform before using its output as BIOS evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The host-off condition, BIOS WebUI, source script and 5/30-minute values remain; no reset count is added.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED HOST-OFF BIOS WEB UPDATE WITH INDEPENDENT BOOT VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the chosen image to exact platform/regions, capture WebUI terminal status, follow the approved activation sequence, then independently verify active BIOS, preserved/defaulted settings as specified, POST checkpoints, OS/kernel health, BMC/SEL and recovery readiness.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Platforms whose BMC WebUI vendor workflow supports BIOS update with the host off.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/BIOS/BMC/WebUI/browser, image, version-script and recovery-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor BIOS-over-BMC WebUI update, region preservation, activation and recovery documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable platform/region binding, settings contract, console-based POST evidence and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Proves bootability and configuration state rather than only WebUI completion or a version string.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A successful upload can still leave the host unbootable or settings reset; independent POST/OS evidence is mandatory.

project_override_considerations: Projects may specify images, regions, settings preservation and reset/power method. Completion is limited to the named platform/plan and cannot claim other BIOS regions or configuration behavior.
expected_evidence: Approved BIOS/platform/region transition matrix and hashes
Manual WebUI image selection, confirmation, progress and terminal status
Post-update BIOS version, settings, POST/OS/kernel/BMC/SEL health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently identifies BIOS WebUI update with host off. Versions, region/preservation behavior, activation and expanded success evidence are project inputs; DeepSeek's single-reset wording is not imported.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target and attended operation are clear. Missing images and acceptance values do not create permanent BLOCKED under V3.1; manual WebUI core makes the case MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps host-off and BIOS scope, rejects browser substitution and unsupported single-reset wording.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains BIOS recovery and POST safeguards while changing BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Makes configuration and POST evidence explicit while separating readiness from capability and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a WebUI success banner or raw version alone from hiding region, settings or boot regressions.
independent_technical_reasoning: The firmware target and lifecycle are understandable once a project supplies exact images and activation requirements. Because the source requires an attended WebUI operation and acceptance, the core is manual even though agents can automate surrounding evidence collection.
